basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled Golden Gate Heights home featuring an ideal floor plan for large families. With 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths, and expansive common living spaces, this home offers both comfort and functionality. The top floor boasts an open living room with soaring ceilings, seamlessly connecting to the dining area and modern kitchen. This level also includes 3 bedrooms and 3 baths, featuring two primary suites, plus a side-by-side laundry closet for added convenience.  An interior staircase leads to the spacious ground floor, where you'll find a huge family room, wet bar, powder room, and two additional ensuite bedrooms. The home also offers a large one-car garage with ample storage. A separate side entrance provides easy access to the lower level, making it a great space for guests or extended family. Additional upgrades include radiant heating, a tankless water heater, and newer solid oak hardwood floors. Perfectly situated just two blocks from MUNI lines, Taraval Street shops and restaurants, West Portal Village, and West Portal Playground, this move-in-ready home even offers partial ocean views - checking all your boxes!
